post.title: Why does everything need an app now?
post.body_preview: I just want a coffee maker that makes coffee and a washer that washes clothes.  It feels like we’re paying more for features nobody asked for while the actual quality gets worse...
post.top_comment: To buy and sell your information under the guise of convenience
